subject: Onboarding cadence & success criteria for Olive Analytics trial - next steps
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Novak <emma@olive-analytics.com>, Timothy Gray <timothy.gray@olivedata.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — onboarding cadence & success criteria

Hi Emma / Tim,

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap from today plus a proposed lightweight onboarding cadence so we can kick off a short evaluation next week. I captured the items we discussed and suggested owners/timeline — please flag anything that needs to change.

Summary of agreed success criteria (we'll measure these during the 3-week evaluation):
- End-to-end latency: average < 350ms for 99th percentile on the 3 main workflows (inbound parsing, entity extraction, response generation)
- False positive rate on entity extraction < 4% on the sample set you provided
- Cost target: token inference cost below your current vendor by >= 20% for baseline traffic profile
- Integration: connector pulls incremental data from S3 and responds to API calls without schema workarounds

Proposed onboarding cadence (compressed 3-week PvE):
- Week 0 (kickoff): alignment, security handshake, data access, deploy a disposable test endpoint
- Week 1: baseline eval runs + perf tuning (metrics collection)
- Week 2: quality gates & reruns on adjusted prompts/quantization profiles
- End of Week 3: final readout and decision runbook (go/no-go + recommendations)

Ownership (Redwood / Olive):
- Data & access: Olive (Timothy) — share S3 paths and an IAM read role
- Security/compliance touchpoint: Olive security (cc'd Emma) and Redwood security (Marcus)
- Trial orchestration & telemetry: Redwood (Laura) — weekly check-ins, metrics dashboard
- Integration owner: Olive (TBD) — help with API contract acceptance tests

Next steps / asks (actionable):
1) Emma / Tim: confirm the success criteria above or add 1-2 business KPIs you care most about (by EOD today)
2) Timothy: provide S3 bucket path + temporary read credentials OR a short window to run a connector (ideally by Wed, 5/5)
3) Marcus: internal infra checklist + recommended instance sizes (Marcus, can you confirm)
4) I'll send a kickoff invite for Thursday morning and attach the draft POC plan + SOW draft for review

Attachments: POC-Plan-v1.xlsx, SOW-draft.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to moving fast.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142
From: Emma Novak <emma@olive-analytics.com>

Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — onboarding cadence & success criteria

Thanks Laura — that looks great and very aligned. Two quick clarifications: 

1) Success metrics: Can we add a business KPI — 'auto-classify accuracy' for our ticket triage use case, target >= 88% (this is the metric our ops team watches)
2) Data access: We prefer providing a temporary IAM role rather than static creds. I can get that to you by Wed morning. Also, who on Redwood's side will handle the SOC/attestation questions?

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround, Emma.

I booked a 45-minute kickoff: Thu, May 6 at 09:30 PT (calendar invite sent). Proposed agenda:
- 10m introductions & scope confirmation
- 10m security & data access plan (Marcus + Olive security)
- 15m onboarding steps & telemetery/metric expectations (Laura)
- 10m next steps, timeline, and owner signoff

Action list before kickoff: 
- Emma: confirm auto-classify KPI to include (88% target) and share the IAM role by Wed 5/5
- Timothy: sample S3 path or a 2-hour window to run the connector
- Marcus: drop the SOC-2 summary and the infra checklist in the Drive folder
- Ben (CC): I'll loop you into the weekly check-in cadence; you'll own the ops sync after Week 1

I'll upload a trimmed POC-Plan-v1.xlsx (workbook with measurement templates) to the Drive folder and attach the SOW draft to the calendar invite. If anything blocks the Thur kickoff, reply-all and we'll move to Fri morning.

See you Thursday — thanks all.
